title: Sexual orgasms can be as effective as nasal decongestants
description: Researchers measured nasal airflow resistance immediately before and after orgasm, and at intervals up to 60 minutes later. Nasal airflow improvement was comparable to oxymetazoline spray (a standard decongestant) and lasted for approximately 45 minutes. The effect is mediated by the autonomic nervous system — a potentially side-effect-free treatment for chronic nasal congestion.
